name: Paroksh Saxena
bio: A Computer Science graduate from IIT Bombay with stints at Myntra, Goldman Sachs, and now a startup called Mason. An outdoor sports enthusiast who has completed 10k, 21k, 50k, and 100k runs.

name: Manoj Kumar
bio: A Computer Science engineer from Tamil Nadu, Manoj works as a Digital Marketing Manager at redBus. He moved to Bangalore after the pandemic and loves blending technology with marketing.

name: Shweta Jain
bio: Am experienced introvert with an MBA is quietness :) Have another MBA in Finance, working for last 16 years now with HCL as operations head. Have a lovely family of two notoriously naughty kids and a caring husband. I love to read and write and everything else thats into creative side.

name: Richa Patel
bio: I am Richa, originally from M.P, currently working as a Product Manager at Gojek with 7+ years of experience, and an IIT Kharagpur alum. I find joy in trying new activities. I enjoy staying active with running, weight training, and badminton. In my free time, I love to paint, read, watch movies, play board games, jam to music, and just have a good time.

name: Khushboo Agarwal
bio: A Chartered Accountant leading corporate business strategy at Go Digit Insurance, Khushboo has lived in Ahmedabad, Mumbai, and now Bangalore. A solo traveller, writer, and painter who believes gratitude turns what we have into enough.

name: Rohit Gupta
bio: A Data Scientist and VP at HSBC, Rohit is a CS engineer from Kanpur with a love for food, freestyle dance, and tennis. A proud father who is endlessly fun-loving and always up for a good conversation.

name: Anup Sahoo
bio: I am Anup Sahoo, originally from Odisha and now living in Bangalore. I am an engineer with a Master’s from the University of Liverpool, and after nine years at Sony PlayStation, I now lead the AI practice at Valtech India for a luxury retail account. At home, my world is my family and my son Sacheet, with whom I love building small tech projects on weekends. Outside work, I enjoy playing with my Raspberry Pi, running my small AI side practice, and going for treks whenever I get the chance.
